Container.Name: AMUD-Dashboard
Container.Overview:
Compiled Rust homelab dashboard — app launcher, live Docker telemetry, Plex/Jellyfin/HA badges. Zero YAML; config in SQLite via the web UI. ~35–100MB RAM for server + agent combined.
**Also install the companion template: AMUD Agent** (search Community Apps for "AMUD Agent"). Both containers must use the same Agent Secret and the same Socket Path.
Docs: https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/docs/installation/unraid
Container.Requires: Install **AMUD Agent** from the same repository. Match Agent Secret and Socket Path on both containers.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the AMUD Dashboard web interface.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: SQLite database and encrypted secrets (backup this folder).

Config.Name: Agent Socket Dir
Config.Description: Shared directory for the Unix socket. Must match the AMUD Agent container exactly.

Config.Name: Agent Secret
Config.Description: Long random string shared with the AMUD Agent container. Required — server will not start without it.

Config.Name: DB_PATH
Config.Description: SQLite file path inside the container.

Config.Name: AMUD_SOCKET_PATH
Config.Description: Unix socket path inside the container.

Config.Name: BIND_ADDR
Config.Description: Address the web server binds to.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal HTTP port (must match Web UI Port mapping).
